item_name: Rothco G.I. Type 5-pack P38 Can Openers
item_short_desc: Be prepared for any situation with Rothco's GI Type 5-Pack P38 Can Openers. Originally designed for the military, these compact and durable tools are perfect for camping, survival kits, or everyday use. Lightweight and easy to carry, the P38 can opener is an essential addition to your outdoor or emergency gear, offering reliable performance when you need it most.
